title.narrative: Building the UAE’s Capacity for Carbon Trading Under Article 6

description.narrative: The UAE has indicated its interest to participate in international carbon markets as a buyer, seeking to purchase ITMOs to enable it to deliver over and above its NDCs targets. Based on this, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has approached GGGI to seek support and guidance on utilization of article 6, to enable UAE’s preparation in participating in the international carbon market as a buyer country of ITMOs. The initial scope of work is aimed at delivering building capacity within the MOCCAE and other relevant entities in the short term, leading to the development of a national strategy and roadmap. At the initial stage, the ministry would like GGGI’s support to build an understanding of the systematic steps that a buying country needs to take as well as understanding of the movement of ITMOs, structure of transactions as well as the obligations between buyer and seller countries. The capacity building and awareness activities will enable the UAE to establish a coherent strategy for its participation in the carbon market. Additionally, GGGI will also avail an expert to participate in a potential side-event or panel discussion at the Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week or other agreed upon event in the UAE.
